name: The Prophecy of Mosh'aru
label: Quest
description: The Prophecy of Mosh'aru: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The ancient prophecy of Mosh'aru speaks of a way to contain the god Hakkar's essence. It was written on two tablets and taken to the troll city of Zul'Farrak, west of Gadgetzan.
The first tablet is held by the long-dead troll Theka the Martyr. It is said his persecutors were cursed into scarabs and now scuttle about his shrine.
The second tablet is held by the hydromancer Velratha, near the sacred pool of Gahz'rilla.
When you have the tablets, bring them to me.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the tablets of the Prophecy of Mosh'aru, friend?
When I gain the tablets, I will study them, and learn how to contain the essence of Hakkar!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, this is good. I can fuse these ancient tablets together, and then study their hidden secrets.
My debt to you grows, friend. And it will grow further still.
